description: This PHP class defines a Drupal form for configuring database settings and rewriting the settings.php file during installation.

classes.name: SiteSettingsForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for configuring database connection and rewriting settings.php during installation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing site path, renderer, and database driver list.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the Drupal installation form for database configuration.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates database connection settings and checks for errors.

methods.name: getDatabaseErrors
methods.description: Retrieves and formats database connection errors.

methods.name: getDatabaseErrorsTemplate
methods.description: Returns a render array template for displaying database errors.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Processes form submission, updates settings.php, and verifies database connection.

methods.name: createRandomConfigDirectory
methods.description: Creates a unique directory for configuration synchronization.
